description: Elections Commission - Notify the names of Mayors, Deputy Mayors ........ etc., who appointed for the Local Authorities - 2018
categorisation: This gazette contains the official declaration of election results for local authorities, specifically naming the appointed Mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairmen, and Vice Chairmen for various local government bodies. It is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and issued by the Elections Commission, making it clearly related to electoral processes and results, which falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
